programs.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programs.desc: Kardea Brown is cooking up a traditional Lowcountry meal with Lowcountry pickled shrimp salad and braised oxtails served over rice and sea island red peas; for dessert, Kardea makes fried puff puff with mango-papaya sauce.

programs.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programs.desc: Kardea Brown invites some friends over for a classic Southern oyster roast with a light and hearty makeover; she prepares roasted oysters with Thai chili mignonette, crab rangoon wonton cups, easy Brunswick stew and slow cooker black cherry cobbler.

programs.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programs.desc: Kardea Brown shares down-home, Southern eats from her South Carolina kitchen; she takes generations of family recipes and makes them her own as she cooks for family and friends at her Sea Island home.

programs.title: The Pioneer Woman
programs.desc: Ree Drummond gives classic dishes a lighter spin, starting with spice-rubbed grilled cauliflower steaks and fully loaded lightened up nachos; she also makes a platter of mushroom "cheesesteak" lettuce wraps and garlic mashed potatoes.

programs.title: The Pioneer Woman
programs.desc: Ree Drummond revisits some of her favorite recipes from her books, including chicken fried steak medallions and pantry pasta 2.0; chicken summer stir-fry is a new spin on a speedy standby; she showcases butter pecan French toast.
